args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

• Clothing:
  • 3-4 shirts/t-shirts
  • 2-3 pairs of shorts/pants
  • 1-2 swimsuits
  • 1-2 light jackets for evening
  • Undergarments and socks
  • Comfortable walking shoes
  • Sandals/flip-flops

• Toiletries:
  • Toothbrush, toothpaste
  • Deodorant
  • Shampoo, conditioner
  • Body wash
  • Razor and shaving cream
  • Makeup and makeup remover (if applicable)
  • Hairbrush/comb
  • Contact lenses and solution (if applicable)
  • Prescription medication and any necessary documentation

• Electronics:
  • Smartphone and charger
  • Laptop and charger (if necessary)
  • Camera and charger
  • Portable charger
  • Universal power adapter
  • Waterproof phone case

• Travel documents:
  • Passport
  • Driver's license
  • Travel insurance documents
  • Hotel reservation
  • Flight itinerary
  • Car rental agreement (if applicable)

• Miscellaneous:
  • Reef-safe sunscreen
  • Sunglasses
  • Beach towel
  • Snorkeling gear (if applicable)
  • Water bottle
  • Collapsible cooler (if planning to bring perishables)
  • Snacks
  • Reading material/entertainment
  • First aid kit
  • Travel-size games
  • Cash and credit cards
  • Small daypack for daily excursions

• Hawaii-specific items:
  • Light rain jacket
  • Swim goggles
  • Beach bag
  • Reef-safe sunscreen
  • Insect repellent
  • Water shoes
  • Snorkeling mask
  • Snorkeling fins
  • Snorkeling vest (if necessary)
  • Beach umbrella (if planning to spend extended periods on the beach)

• Notes:
  • Check with airline for any specific baggage restrictions
  • Consider packing clothes that can be easily mixed and matched
  • Roll clothes to save space in luggage
  • Leave some extra space in luggage for souvenirs
  • Consider packing a small portable laundry detergent pack
  • Check the weather forecast before departure
  • Consider packing a small backpack for daily excursions
